question_audit.evidence: Question text, tables or figures inspected; independent worked solutions and numerical checks in ssce-written.test.js.
Prompt says angle SRQ = 41 degrees; diagram labels angle KSP = 41 degrees. The stated centre angle and bisector make the two versions inconsistent.

Official question image uses strict 2n-3 < 37 and repeats Kontor in age relationship. Official solution instead uses <=37 and Kontor:Gapson=3:2; secondary transcription uses <=37 and reversed age ratio. These produce different set probabilities and bonuses. Hold pending authentic paper: do not select an answer by source majority.

Coordinates P(3,5), Q(-5,7) recovered from secondary transcription and corroborated by official solution image. Independently checked midpoint (-1,6), perpendicular slope 4 and line y=4x+10. Adapted brief, not authenticated full-paper import.
Source asks for the bearing of X and Y without direction; linked observation image also returns 404.

Area 32pi cm2 recovered from secondary transcription and official solution image. Official solution confirms full perimeter includes diameter. Independently checked 8 sides, radius 8 and perimeter 8pi+16. Adapted brief, not authenticated full-paper import.
